note: Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey company page reports 'Total Shipments 352 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 5', 'Ports 5', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Of the rows actually rendered (5 shipment rows + 5 supplier rows + 4 buyer rows), ALL 5 dated shipment rows are IMPORTS INTO INDIA from Chinese suppliers (Taizhou Alpha, Shanghai Sollant, Shandong Luktik) via Qingdao/Ningbo/Shanghai to Mundra and Nhava Sheva, dated 2026-01-20 to 2026-02-28, HS 84144030 and 84149019. So the 352-record figure is an import count, not an export count. Slug variants tried: /venus-compressors-private-limited (352 records, populated), /venus-compressors-pvt-ltd (page loads but zero records), /venus-compressors (zero records). Second sources blocked: volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no independent export confirmation was possible. HS note: declared HS 841440 ('Compressors used in refrigerating equipment') does not match the observed trade, which is air compressors under 84144030/84149019 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base with the factual code recorded. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is also inconsistent with the observed goods (industrial screw air compressors). Role: appears to be an importer/distributor of Chinese air compressors rather than a manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source read, not estimated. No evidence of liquidation or strike-off was found, so no rejection ground applies.
